g.text: The offer releases $75m of future obligations. The $79.9m already contributed stays invested,
and reducing still leaves a $675m total commitment.
A commitment reduction is not an immediate $75m cash refund
or an immediate $75m reduction in PE NAV.
Ordinary 2009 call threshold: $225m if retaining, $202.5m if reducing; calls above 30% need advisory-committee approval.
Source: Q6 OPERF decision!B6:C9; Inputs!C26:C31; Case pp. 1, 6. $m; capacity to meet calls does not establish that the extra $75m is attractive.
